email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 54-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their first dose of DemoZanix (dose: 5mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-03-24.
Approximately 7 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
P. Duval (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter666@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
